headline: Bruins lay an absolute egg at the Garden in Ottawa loss
morning_brew: I am still trying to scrub the memory of Monday night out of my brain with a stiff drink and a long shower. The B's turned the Garden into a skating rink for the Senators, letting them waltz out of here with a four-to-one win that felt even worse than the score suggests. We looked like we were skating in mud from the opening faceoff, falling behind early and never once looking like we had the pulse to fight back. It is only October, but watching this team give away points on home ice like they are handing out candy on Halloween makes me want to pull my hair out.

Jeremy Swayman did not have his usual magic, getting tagged four times on twenty-four shots, and aside from a late goal by James Hagens, the offense looked like they were stuck in neutral. Ottawa played like they actually wanted to be there, while we gave them enough space in the defensive zone to hold a town meeting. The Hub is already getting restless, and honestly, can you blame us? This roster is miles better than the garbage product we watched for sixty minutes on Monday night.

We have a few days to figure out which end of the stick is which before Utah hits the ice on Thursday. I am betting the practice schedule is gonna be hell, and it better be, because that effort was flat-out embarrassing. If we have any delusions of being serious contenders in the Atlantic, we need to stop spotting every opponent a head start and hoping our goaltender can pull a miracle out of his hat every single night.

news_digest.headline: Stutzle's 3-point game, Ullmark and Ersson power Senators to a 4-1 win over Bruins
news_digest.dans_take: Watching Stutzle treat our defense like traffic cones made for a miserable Monday.

news_digest.headline: Breslow, Tracy: Red Sox not overly reliant on analytics
news_digest.dans_take: I do not care about the numbers or the philosophy, just give me a winning team at Fenway.

trend_watch.dans_take: He is the backbone of this team, but he looked like he was reading the menu while the pucks were flying by him.

trend_watch.trend: Scored the lone Bruins goal in the third period to prevent the shutout.
trend_watch.dans_take: He managed to find the net, but it was like bringing a squirt gun to a house fire.
